name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes federated media not playing. Federated items were created with no Path, so the media source Jellyfin builds for them came out as a Placeholder - unplayable by definition, and it also suppressed the remote-content probe that would have discovered the codecs, because that probe is skipped whenever the first source is a placeholder. Items now carry the remote stream URL on Path (plus IsShortcut/ShortcutPath, the same mechanism .strm files use), so Jellyfin builds a real HTTP source, probes it for codec info, and plays it through its normal direct-play/transcode paths. Existing federated items are rebuilt once to pick this up (watch progress on them is reset). Audio now streams from the audio endpoint rather than the video one.
